data_description.device_profile: Select the matching device profile for your Zendure system. The profile contains tuned control parameters.
data_description.soc_entity: Sensor with the current battery state of charge in percent. Central basis for all decisions.
data_description.soc_limit_entity: Optional sensor from the Zendure integration that reports active BMS limits, such as charge or discharge blocking.
data_description.pack_capacity_kwh: Usable capacity of a single battery pack in kWh. Multiplied by the number of installed packs to calculate total capacity.
data_description.battery_ac_power_entity: Sensor for the battery AC power. The value must be positive during discharge. Recommended: sensor.solarflow_2400_ac_bat_in_out
data_description.additional_battery_charge_entity: Optional sensor of a second battery system. If this sensor reports positive charge power, Battery SmartFlow AI blocks discharging.
data_description.additional_battery_discharge_entity: Optional sensor of a second battery system. If this sensor reports positive discharge power, Battery SmartFlow AI blocks charging to avoid battery-to-battery charging.
data_description.capacity_entity: Optional sensor with automatically calculated available battery capacity in kWh, for example from the Zendure integration. If set, it overrides the manual calculation.
data_description.installed_pv_wp: Installed theoretical PV module power of the system in Wp. This value is used for relative PV-context thresholds and other PV-related logic.
data_description.pv_entity: Sensor with the current PV power in watts. Used to detect surplus.
data_description.native_pv_entity: Optional sensor for PV power connected directly to the battery system. During AC charging this power gets priority inside the maximum charge limit. Do not select the total house PV sensor here.
data_description.pv_forecast_today_entity: Optional sensor with today's PV daily forecast, for example from Solcast PV Forecast. The forecast is only an additional planning input and is not required for the integration.
data_description.pv_forecast_tomorrow_entity: Optional sensor with tomorrow's PV daily forecast, for example from Solcast PV Forecast. The forecast is only an additional planning input and is not required for the integration.
data_description.price_now_entity: Sensor with the current electricity price, for example Tibber. Used for economic decisions.
data_description.price_export_entity: Sensor with price forecast data, for example Tibber / EPEX. Enables price planning.
data_description.grid_mode: Choose how your grid usage is measured: one combined sensor or separate sensors for import and export.
data_description.grid_power_entity: A single sensor with positive power for grid import and negative power for export.
data_description.grid_import_entity: Sensor with current grid import power in watts.
data_description.grid_export_entity: Sensor with current grid export power in watts.
data_description.ac_mode_entity: Select entity from the Zendure integration that switches between charging (INPUT) and discharging (OUTPUT).
data_description.input_limit_entity: Number entity for setting the charge power in watts.
data_description.output_limit_entity: Number entity for setting the discharge power in watts.
data_description.offgrid_power_entity: Optional sensor for the power of the Zendure off-grid / island socket. Positive values are interpreted as an active load at the island socket.
data_description.offgrid_mode_entity: Optional select sensor for the Zendure off-grid / island socket mode. The mode is only read and is never set by Battery SmartFlow AI.
data_description.feed_in_tariff: Compensation per exported kWh in the same currency unit as the electricity prices. Used as a fallback when no valid dynamic feed-in price is available.
data_description.dynamic_feed_in_price_entity: Optional numeric Home Assistant sensor for the current dynamic feed-in price. A valid sensor value, including zero or a negative price, takes priority over the fixed feed-in tariff.

init.title: Battery SmartFlow AI settings
init.description: Select the settings area you want to edit. Device-specific control values are managed automatically by the selected device profile.

general.title: Battery SmartFlow AI settings – General
general.description: General system settings. Device-specific control values remain part of the selected device profile.

data_description.installed_pv_wp: Installed theoretical PV module power of the system in Wp. This value is used for relative PV-context thresholds and other PV-related logic.

debug_start.title: Start debug recording
debug_start.description: Use this support function only for troubleshooting. Technical states and configured entity IDs are recorded for a limited time; passwords, tokens and API keys are filtered. Progress is shown by the debug status sensors in the Battery SmartFlow AI device view. Up to 10 packages are retained under /config/bsfai/debug/.

data_description.duration_minutes: Select 10, 30, 60 or 120 minutes. The recording stops and exports automatically.

debug_stop.title: Debug recording active
debug_stop.description: The recording ends at {recording_end}. Samples recorded so far: {sample_count}. Current progress is also shown by the debug status sensors. Submit to stop now and export the collected package.

debug_started.title: Debug recording started
debug_started.description: The debug recording is running. Progress is shown by the debug status sensors in the Battery SmartFlow AI device view. Submit to return to the settings menu.

debug_stopped.title: Debug recording stopped
debug_stopped.description: The recording was stopped and the JSON debug package was exported. Its location is shown by the Last debug package sensor. Submit to return to the settings menu.

expert.title: Battery SmartFlow AI settings – Expert mode
expert.description: Advanced protection, diagnostic and planning functions. Learned charge-window planning is used automatically once enough learning data is available. It can be disabled here if needed. Cell-voltage protection requires expert mode to be enabled first.

data_description.expert_mode_enabled: Enables the advanced expert area for additional protection and diagnostic functions.
data_description.learned_planning_enabled: When enabled, Battery SmartFlow AI automatically uses learned charge-window planning once enough learning data is available. Until then, classic planning remains active. When disabled, classic planning is always used.

expert_cell_voltage.title: Edit control profile – Cell-voltage protection
expert_cell_voltage.description: Optionally enable cell-voltage protection. When enabled, the next step configures the cell-voltage sensors and protection thresholds.

data_description.cell_voltage_protection_enabled: Enables cell-voltage-based battery protection. Afterwards you can configure the sensors for the lowest cell voltage per battery pack and the protection thresholds.

expert_cell_voltage_config.title: Edit control profile – Cell-voltage configuration
expert_cell_voltage_config.description: Configure the sensors for the lowest cell voltage per battery pack and the related protection thresholds.

data_description.lowest_cell_voltage_pack_1: Sensor for the lowest cell voltage of battery pack 1. This value is used for global protection evaluation.
data_description.lowest_cell_voltage_pack_2: Sensor for the lowest cell voltage of battery pack 2. This value is used for global protection evaluation.
data_description.lowest_cell_voltage_pack_3: Sensor for the lowest cell voltage of battery pack 3. This value is used for global protection evaluation.
data_description.lowest_cell_voltage_pack_4: Sensor for the lowest cell voltage of battery pack 4. This value is used for global protection evaluation.
data_description.lowest_cell_voltage_pack_5: Sensor for the lowest cell voltage of battery pack 5. This value is used for global protection evaluation.
data_description.lowest_cell_voltage_pack_6: Sensor for the lowest cell voltage of battery pack 6. This value is used for global protection evaluation.
data_description.cell_voltage_warning: Threshold for critically low cell voltage. Used to trigger emergency charging or protection measures early.
data_description.cell_voltage_cutoff: Hard lower limit for cell voltage. If this is reached or undercut, discharging is blocked.
data_description.cell_voltage_resume: Recovery threshold above the warning and cutoff limits. A cell-voltage emergency charge remains active until this voltage is reached; discharging can then also be re-enabled after cell-voltage protection.
